title: Create contract with valid inputs
description: Verify that a borrower can successfully create a loan contract when all inputs are valid and within allowed ranges

steps.description: Navigate to Create Contract form
Input loan amount greater than or equal to Rs. 100
Select due date/time at least 48 hours and no more than 90 days from current date
Enter lender phone number with valid Indian format prefixed with +91
Optionally enter a reason for the loan
Submit contract creation form
Check contract is created with status REQUESTED and visible in borrower and lender dashboards

title: Contract creation validation for amount below Rs.100
description: Verify form prevents contract creation when the loan amount is less than Rs. 100, with appropriate error message

steps.description: Navigate to Create Contract form
Input loan amount Rs. 99
Fill other fields validly
Submit contract creation form
Form presents validation error indicating minimum amount requirement
Contract is not created

title: Contract creation validation for due date outside allowed range
description: Ensure loan contract cannot be created if due date is less than 48 hours or more than 90 days from contract creation

steps.description: Navigate to Create Contract form
Input valid loan amount
Set due date to 24 hours from now (less than 48 hours)
Enter valid lender phone
Attempt to submit form
Form shows validation error for due date minimum limit
Change due date to 91 days from now (exceeding max limit)
Attempt to submit form
Form shows validation error for due date maximum limit

title: Contract creation validation for invalid lender phone
description: Verify that the lender phone number must be in Indian format prefixed with +91 and invalid formats are rejected

steps.description: Navigate to Create Contract form
Input valid amount and due date
Enter lender phone without +91 prefix
Try submitting the form
Form shows phone format validation error
Enter lender phone with invalid characters
Try submitting the form
Form shows phone format validation error

title: One active loan request per borrower-lender pair limit
description: Confirm that only one active loan request can exist for the same borrower-lender pair at any time

steps.description: Create a contract from borrower to lender with status REQUESTED
Attempt to create another loan contract request to the same lender before the first is accepted or rejected
System blocks the second request creation and shows appropriate notification/message

title: Lender can view incoming loan requests with Reliability Stars
description: Ensure lenders see incoming loan requests along with the borrower's Reliability Stars and review information

steps.description: Log in as lender user
Navigate to dashboard or loan requests view
Incoming loan requests list is displayed with borrower Reliability Stars visible
Negative reviews are shown pinned for borrowers with outstanding issues

title: Lender can accept, reject, or counter loan requests
description: Verify that lender can perform actions to accept, reject, or send a counter offer on loan requests

steps.description: Log in as lender and open a requested contract detail
Click Accept and confirm
Contract status changes to ACTIVE
Repeat with another contract and click Reject
Contract status changes to REJECTED
Repeat with another contract and send counter-offer with modified terms
Counter offer is sent and contract status updated accordingly

title: Borrower can request up to 3 extensions per contract
description: Verify borrower can request contract extensions up to a maximum of 3 times, with UI feedback

steps.description: Log in as borrower and open an ACTIVE contract
Request an extension and submit
Extension request is recorded and shown in contract detail
Repeat extension requests until 3 total extensions reached
After 3rd extension request, a final extension banner is displayed in the UI
Attempt a 4th extension request
System disallows further extension requests with appropriate message

title: Lender reviews and responds to extension requests
description: Verify that lenders can approve or deny borrower extension requests and status updates accordingly

steps.description: Log in as lender and open contract with pending extension request
Review extension request details
Approve the extension request
Contract due date is updated and extension count incremented
Repeat for a different request and deny the extension
Extension request marked denied and contract due date unchanged

title: Borrower uploads payment proof to initiate settlement
description: Verify borrower can upload payment proof images to start contract settlement process, contract status moves to SETTLE_PENDING

steps.description: Log in as borrower and open ACTIVE or DUE contract
Upload payment proof image with valid format
Submit payment proof
Contract status changes to SETTLE_PENDING
Payment proof image preview is available in contract detail

title: Lender approves or denies payment proofs for settlement
description: Confirm that lenders can review, approve, or deny submitted payment proof images and contract status updates accordingly

steps.description: Log in as lender and open contract in SETTLE_PENDING status
View payment proof image preview
Approve the payment proof
Contract status changes to SETTLED
Repeat and deny the payment proof on different contract
Contract status reverts or remains ACTIVE as per denial workflow

title: Reliability Stars calculation updates on repayment and reviews
description: Verify that borrower’s Reliability Stars update correctly based on repayment timeliness and lender reviews including pinned negative reviews

steps.description: Complete contract repayment with lender posting review indicating timely payment
Reliability Stars increase or remain stable accurately for the borrower
Post a negative review due to late payment or unresolved dues
Negative review is pinned and Reliability Stars decrease accordingly
Resolve outstanding dues and lender removes negative review
Pinned negative review is unpinned and Reliability Stars update positively

title: Role-based visibility: Reliability Stars visible only to lenders
description: Confirm that the borrower’s Reliability Stars and scores are visible only to lender users and hidden from borrower and other roles

steps.description: Log in as borrower and navigate to loan requests and contract views
Reliability Stars and score are not visible or accessible
Log in as lender and view the borrower’s loan requests and contract details
Reliability Stars and score are clearly visible

title: UI validation errors display correct messages
description: Verify all validation error messages for contract creation fields (amount, due date, phone) are accurate, clear, and prominent

steps.description: Trigger amount validation error by entering < Rs. 100
Error message shown: 'Amount must be at least Rs. 100'
Trigger due date validation errors by setting date outside 48h-90d range
Error message shown: 'Due date must be between 48 hours and 90 days from now'
Trigger phone validation error with incorrect format
Error message shown: 'Lender phone must be Indian format starting with +91'

title: Offline-first data persistence and retrieval
description: Validate that user and contract data persist locally and can be accessed and updated reliably when offline using LocalStorage

steps.description: Create and save contract data while online
Go offline and reload the app
Previously saved contract and user data load correctly from LocalStorage
Perform CRUD operations on contracts and user profiles offline
Data changes persist locally without errors
Go online and verify synchronization or data consistency
Data is consistent and no data loss occurs

title: SPA routing navigates correctly across all major pages
description: Verify smooth SPA routing for all defined pages: login, dashboard, contracts (list/detail/create), profiles, search, analytics, settings, and help

steps.description: Log in and navigate sequentially to dashboard, create contract, contracts list, contract detail, user profiles, search, analytics, settings, help, and an invalid URL
Each route loads the expected page content without full page reload
Invalid URL displays NotFound page
Browser back and forward buttons work as expected within the SPA

title: Search and user switching functionality
description: Ensure users can search profiles and switch between users seamlessly

steps.description: Navigate to Search Profiles page
Perform search queries with valid keywords and partial matches
Search results list relevant user profiles accurately filtered
Select a user from search results and switch to that user using the User Switcher UI
App state updates to the selected user and reflects in profile and dashboard views

title: Payment proof upload validations and image preview
description: Verify payment proof upload supports valid image types, rejects invalid types, and allows preview before submission

steps.description: Open payment proof upload dialog
Attempt to upload valid image file formats (jpg, png)
Images load correctly and preview is shown
Attempt to upload invalid file types (pdf, txt)
Upload is rejected with clear validation error

title: Contract status lifecycle flows
description: Verify contract transitions properly through statuses: REQUESTED, ACTIVE, DUE, SETTLE_PENDING, SETTLED, REJECTED according to user actions

steps.description: Create a contract, verify initial status REQUESTED
Lender accepts contract, status changes to ACTIVE
Simulate due date passing, status updates to DUE
Borrower uploads payment proof, status becomes SETTLE_PENDING
Lender approves settlement, status updates to SETTLED
Create contract and lender rejects it, status changes to REJECTED
All status changes correspond correctly to the business rules and UI updates
